name: Cowork Use Case One-Pager
description: Turn a Cowork conversation, into a one-page HTML use case write-up — narrative, impact figures, workflow steps, and outputs.
author: Tim Sparks
coverImageAlt: A dark editorial press turns a cyan ribbon of blank conversation tokens into a single warm-paper page with simple cyan and orange shapes.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: one compact editorial press transforms a flowing cyan conversation ribbon into a single finished warm-paper sheet, a clear metaphor for turning a workflow conversation into a concise one-page use case
Scene/backdrop: uncluttered navy work surface against a warm-paper studio field with generous calm negative space
Subject: a tactile dark-slate press at center; abstract cyan workflow tokens travel in on one continuous ribbon, and one portrait-oriented paper sheet emerges with only bold unlabeled geometric zones: a cyan circle, a short rail of raised dots, and one small orange impact block
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; strong press-and-page silhouette with simplified forms legible on a small gallery card
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical, with restrained cyan backlighting and a sparing warm orange accent
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, interface labels, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no pseudo-writing, writing-like lines, product UI, browser chrome, Microsoft Fluent gradients, or Microsoft branding
Targeted correction: keep every token inside the incoming cyan ribbon completely blank and simple, using only plain rounded tiles, dots, and empty speech-bubble silhouettes; remove all interior line clusters, hand shapes, icons, symbols, and markings while preserving the press and finished page
